framework: review-specific mixed-method risk-of-bias and applicability appraisal

dimensions.name: internal validity
dimensions.rationale: Random framing and the crossed actual-control manipulation isolate perceived automation, though 21 compromised tele-operated sessions were excluded.

dimensions.name: measurement validity
dimensions.rationale: Self-report, automated facial behavior, and blind transcript ratings converge, but none verifies truth or clinical accuracy of disclosure.

dimensions.name: external validity
dimensions.rationale: A single virtual human and health-screening setting may not generalize to text-only, field, or high-stakes interviews.

applicability: Strong mechanism evidence about perceived automation; indirect evidence about autonomous interviewer performance.
